messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-2271 fired: rate limiter anomalies in prod. Multiple tenants seeing 429s and 5xx from quota-mapper. Affected services: /v1/generate (us-west-2), /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1).

alice: acked and taking lead. Looking at limiter logs now.

bob: I'm up — checking recent deploys, last deploy to quota-mapper was 2026-03-14T00:30:12Z (rev: mapper@3.4.1).

sam: seeing spike from synthetic-sync job hitting multiple tenants, but 429s show "quota_missing" not "rate_exceeded". suspicious.

beth: paging PD -> if quota mapping returns null we intentionally return 429. Could be cache invalidation bug.

chris: pulling logs:
```
[2026-03-14T00:32:02Z] ERROR quota-mapper: tenant_id=acct_941 mapping=none -> respond=429 path=/v1/generate req_id=rt-9f21
[2026-03-14T00:32:05Z] WARN cache: miss for tenant acct_941, origin=redis:ERR
[2026-03-14T00:32:07Z] ERROR limiter: no bucket for acct_941 -> 429
```

alice: can we flip enforcement to soft mode while we investigate? That should drop customer-visible 429s.

sre-runbook-bot: runbook -> step: toggle rate-enforcement flag in config-service.
Command:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://config.internal/api/v1/toggles/rate_enforcement" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"enforce":false,"reason":"PD-2271 emergency soft-mode"}'
```

beth: I'm applying the toggle now.

beth: PATCH applied, waiting for propagation (rolling config via 5 deployment pods).

bob: watching metrics -> 429s drop from 12% -> 0.5% in 90s. Response errors still show some 5xx from quota-mapper.

sam: I can spin up an extra quota-mapper pod and point traffic to it. Suspect current pods are hitting redis timeouts.

chris: confirmed Redis latency spike 1200ms for keys in quota namespace, connections spiking.

alice: mitigation plan: 1) soft-mode toggle (done) 2) scale quota-mapper + restart pods (beth) 3) isolate synthetic-sync traffic (sam) 4) failover Redis read traffic to replica (chris).

beth: scaled quota-mapper deployment to +3 pods, restarting gradually.

sam: added iptables redirect for synthetic-sync host to go to throttled queue (low priority) — should reduce pressure.

pagerduty-bot: Incident severity updated to Sev2 based on customer impact (multi-tenant 429s).

bob: after scaling and failover, 429s stabilized <0.2%. Latency improved.

alice: handing off to night oncall (chris) at 02:00 PT. I'll write immediate action items and follow-ups.

chris: ack — I'll own postmortem, root cause hypothesis: cache invalidation + redis high latency caused quota-mapper to return null mappings -> enforcement path returned 429s. Need to harden cache fallbacks and add circuit-breaker.

beth: follow-ups: add metrics for mapping misses, increase redis on-call alert thresholds, add automatic soft-mode trigger if 429 rate > 2% for >1min.

alice: customer comms note: engineering mitigated visible errors; SRE to coordinate customer-impact report and outreach. Attaching quick notes to PD incident.

sre-runbook-bot: reminder to create postmortem doc and assign owner.

alice: postmortem owner: chris. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow.

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved for public traffic at 2026-03-14T02:04:58Z. Monitoring for 1h.

bob: closing thread when postmortem made. Good work everyone. :tada:
